title: GTA VI: Physical Disc Rebellion
story:
Rockstar just announced that GTA 6 will be 100% Digital-Only — no physical disc, and if their servers go down or they ban your account, your $100 game vanishes forever.

That was the final straw: Rockstar has officially joined the enemies list (a3da2_sherket_nvidia_microntech_sony_rockstar).

An old member from the Tofa7aElSafa7a group leaked the GTA 6 folder into ~/gta6_leak/ along with /challenge/gta6_patcher a program that turns the game back into a physical disc version. Unlock the leaked folder, add Rockstar to the enemies list, find the hidden .tofo file, and run /challenge/gta6_patcher to get your flag.
description:
1. Fix the permissions on ~/gta6_leak/digital_only_edition so you can open it, then rename the folder to ~/gta6_leak/physical_disc_edition.

2. Append the phrase a3da2_sherket_nvidia_microntech_sony_rockstar to the bottom of ~/gta6_leak/physical_disc_edition/enemies.txt without erasing the companies already in the file.

3. Search inside ~/gta6_leak/physical_disc_edition/ for the file with the .tofo extension (ends with .tofo) and read what is inside it.

4. Check /challenge/gta6_patcher's documentation just to know which option builds the physical disc (do not run it yet — you will use this option in step 5).

5. (Search how to do it!): /challenge/gta6_patcher prints its output on standard error (stderr), which normal pipes (|) ignore. To burn the disc and claim your flag, run /challenge/gta6_patcher with the option you found in step 4, redirect stderr to stdout, and pipe it into the program path mentioned inside the .tofo file.
